name: Quote card
what: A post-style quote card - a round picture, a name with a check badge, a handle - pops in with a tilt that settles; the quote comes in word by word, the starred phrase in the accent colour; the counts tick up.

learned_from.what: the post-style card: avatar, name, a two-paragraph quote with one phrase in blue (a still capture; the motion follows the library's rules)

motion: card back.out 18 f from a -5 degree tilt; words 2 f apart rising 8 f; counts 20 f; the card floats
